title: Grateful Dead Live at Golden Hall on 1970-01-10
lineage: Reel (Akai GX636) -> Apogee Mini-Me (24bit/96k) -> Apogee Mini-Dac -> Wavelab 5 -> FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1970 show featuring a standout "Love Light" and fierce Pigpen jams, captured in surprisingly clear raw sound.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the powerful jam sessions and Pigpen’s fire‑fueling vocals, with the Love Light highlighted as a top moment. The recording—sourced from a soundboard—offers better clarity than earlier circulations while retaining a raw, authentic feel that many listeners love.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers give 4‑5 stars, praising both the performance and the improved sound quality; limited number of reviews yields medium confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Improved clarity compared to older copies; raw but listenable mix that captures the live energy without major distortion or drop‑outs.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic and jam‑focused, with Pigpen driving the fire and a strong, memorable Love Light performance anchoring the set.
